# uzc_project (Data Source)

Looks up a single UzCloud project by slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_project" "default" {
  slug = "default"
}

output "project_uuid" {
  value = data.uzc_project.default.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String)

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `icon` (String)
- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`.
- `name` (String)
- `purpose` (String)
- `status` (Boolean)
- `uuid` (String) UzCloud's internal UUID for this project.
